title: Interview guard in agent-spec
item: Interview guard in agent-spec: first ask which systems the agent calls, who owns each and where the docs are; check system claims against docs; for every limit set to none say what ends it; for every money value from a tool say what happens on a mismatch; show what a policy choice leads to
motivation: The interview accepted unreasonable decisions (unlimited lookup retries) and wrong external-system assumptions (a repeated refund call never duplicates) without warning
notes: In the skill since e8ed321. The four guard gates read 1.0 in 3 of 3 baseline trials; 1–9 claims put to the owner per trial, limit 10. These check form only; whether the questions are good is untested until item 17.
